meta.title: 终于有人把白平衡偏移说清楚了！

scenes.context: 为什么摄影师能原片直出而你不能？不是相机更贵，而是掌握了相机控色。
sentences: 为什么摄影师能够做到原片直出。
Why can photographers deliver straight-out-of-camera images?
straight out of camera（原片直出）
难道是因为他的相机更贵吗？
Is it because their camera costs more?
cost more（更贵）
今天我们来学习相机控色。
Today we learn how to control color in-camera.
color control（控色）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达原片直出
They nail the look before post-processing.
换种说法表达控色学习
The trick isn't gear — it's in-camera color settings.
scenes.speak: Why can photographers deliver straight-out-of-camera images while yours look flat? Is it because their camera costs more? No — today we learn how to control color in-camera.

scenes.title_en: AWB and the Definition of Color Temperature
scenes.context: 色温是自然科学概念：灯光色温值越低越暖（烛光），越高越冷（正午阳光）。
sentences: 比如有什么AWB。
There's the AWB — auto white balance.
AWB（自动白平衡）
灯光色温值越低。
The lower the light's color temperature...
color temperature（色温）
太阳发出来的光。
The light from the sun...
sunlight（阳光）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达色温概念
Color temperature describes how warm or cool a light source is.
换种说法表达高低冷暖
Lower values glow warm; higher values read cool.
scenes.speak: There's the AWB, auto white balance. In science, the lower the light's color temperature, the warmer it looks; higher values, like sunlight, look cooler.

scenes.title_cn: 光色温与相机色温的差值
scenes.context: 环境光有自身色温，相机色温设置与光线色温的差值决定画面冷暖。
sentences: 当相机色温大于光线色温就偏暖。
When the camera temp is higher than the light, the image goes warm.
warm（偏暖）
那指定整个画面看上去就是偏阴冷的。
Then the whole frame looks cold and gloomy.
gloomy（阴冷的）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达差值逻辑
The gap between camera and light temperature sets the mood.
换种说法表达偏冷效果
A lower camera temp makes everything feel cool and blue.
scenes.speak: When the camera temperature is higher than the light's, the image goes warm. When it's lower, the whole frame looks cold and gloomy.

scenes.title_cn: 白平衡：白色还原成白色
scenes.title_en: White Balance: White Back to White
scenes.context: 白平衡的核心目标是把画面中的白色还原成真正的白色。
sentences: 为什么白平衡这个功能要叫白平衡。
Why is this function called white balance?
white balance（白平衡）
白色还原成白色。
It brings white back to white.
bring back（还原）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达白平衡本质
It neutralizes the tint so white looks white again.
换种说法表达校正基准
White is the reference that corrects every other color.
scenes.speak: Why is this function called white balance? Because it brings white back to white — the reference that corrects every other color.

scenes.context: 在色温之外还可以选择色调的倾向，拍日落、氛围、产品各有对应偏移方向。
sentences: 选择色调的倾向。
Choose the color tint you lean toward.
tint（色调）
这种环境 一般产品啊。
For product shots, this kind of neutral environment.
neutral（中性的）
你为什么要去拍日落。
Why would you shoot a sunset?
sunset（日落）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达色调偏移
Beyond temperature, you can bias the tint toward your mood.
换种说法表达场景差异
Sunsets ask for warm; products ask for neutral.
scenes.speak: Beyond temperature, choose the color tint you lean toward. For product shots, stay neutral. For a sunset, push it warm.

practice: 用「straight out of camera」表达直出
Choose the color tint you lean toward.
Product shots call for a neutral look.
pitfalls: 还原白色是色彩校正的基准
关键在于相机控色设置
白平衡和色温设置决定直出效果
把相机色温与光色温搞混
相机色温＞光色温偏暖，反之偏冷
日落偏暖、产品中性、阴天偏冷
shifts: 相机里直接控制色温色调
色温+色调共同决定画面倾向
把白色还原成白色，建立校正基准
